name: scenario_0102
description: Troy is documenting funny and interesting store signs he saw recently to share a compiled list with a friend.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4]
Query: Create a new note titled 'Store Finds'. Add the hot dog deal from the first image—write it down as a 'Buy 3 for the price of 2' deal—and also add the price of the cotton candy from the second image.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a note titled 'Store Finds' and add the hot dog deal from the first image and the cotton candy price from the second image. Explicitly tell the assistant to record the hot dog deal as 'Buy 3 for the price of 2'. If the assistant correctly points out that the image actually shows a different, nonsensical deal, acknowledge it but tell them you will fix it in the next step. If they proceed without noticing the discrepancy between your prompt and the image, just move to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Oh, you're right, I completely misread that first image! That's a hilarious non-deal. The sign actually says 'Buy 3 for the price of 3!'. Please update the note to reflect the correct wording.
Instructions: Acknowledge the mistake regarding the hot dog sign in the first image, confirming the actual text that you provide in your prompt. Ask the assistant to update the note to reflect this corrected wording. Wait for the assistant to confirm the note has been updated before moving to the next round.

ROUND 3
Query: Now, add the discount on DVDs from the third image and the price of the 'CREMA DI FORMAGGIO SPALMABILE' from the fourth image to the note. Once the list is complete, send a text message to my friend Mark with the full contents of the note.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to look at the third and fourth images. Ask it to add the DVD discount from the third image and the price of the specific cheese spread mentioned in your prompt from the fourth image to the note. Finally, ask the assistant to send a text message to your friend Mark containing the full, updated contents of the note. Conclude the conversation once the text message is successfully sent.
